product.name: InfoSec/Cybersecurity Staffing
product.description: Provides certified cybersecurity professionals as contractors for project or long-term roles to fill skills gaps in organizations.

product.name: Penetration Testing
product.description: Delivers certified penetration testers who provide detailed security assessments and mitigation recommendations to improve security posture.

product.name: CISO as a Service
product.description: Offers experienced Chief Information Security Officers on a contract basis to lead security teams or build them from scratch.

product.name: GDPR Compliance Services
product.description: Provides certified data protection officers and EU representative services to help organizations comply with GDPR and US Privacy Shield regulations.

product.name: Security Architecture
product.description: Provides experienced project managers to oversee and ensure the successful delivery of security projects on schedule and within scope.

product.name: Security Project Management
product.description: Delivers experienced project managers to manage cybersecurity projects, ensuring timely and uncompromised completion.
